# Canadian Paediatric Society

> The Canadian Paediatric Society is the national association of paediatricians, providing clinical guidance, advocacy, and professional education for child and youth health in Canada.

CPS serves as a home for paediatricians and a voice for children and youth, offering evidence-based clinical resources, continuing education, and policy advocacy across pediatric medicine. The organization prioritizes Indigenous child health, antiracism initiatives, and mental health as strategic priorities.

## Key Topics

- Canadian Paediatric Society
- Clinical Practice
- Pediatric Medicine
- Professional Development
- Position Statements

- Immunization and Vaccines
- Continuing Education

- Medical Education

- First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Health

## Clinical Practice & Resources

- [Clinical Practice](https://cps.ca/en/clinical): CPS clinical practice resources including Caring for Kids program
- [Clinical Tools and Resources](https://cps.ca/en/tools-outils): CPS clinical tools, screening guides, and counselling resources
- [Position Statements and Practice Points](https://cps.ca/en/documents): CPS position statements and practice points for clinical guidance
- [Immunization and Vaccines](https://cps.ca/en/clinical/immunization-and-vaccines): CPS immunization and vaccine guidance including COVID-19 and RSV
- [Choosing Wisely Canada](https://cps.ca/en/tools-outils/choosing-wisely-canada): Choosing Wisely Canada: evidence-based pediatric guidelines and best practices
- [COVID-19 Information and Resources](https://cps.ca/en/tools-outils/covid-19-information-and-resources-for-paediatricians): CPS COVID-19 guidance and vaccination resources for paediatricians

## Professional Education & Events

- [Professional Education](https://cps.ca/en/education): CPS professional education including conferences and continuing education
- [Annual Conferences](https://cps.ca/en/annual-conference): CPS annual conference registration and professional development events
- [National Grand Rounds](https://cps.ca/en/grand-rounds): CPS National Grand Rounds webinars and continuing medical education
- [Lifelong Learning in Paediatrics Courses](https://cps.ca/en/llp): CPS Lifelong Learning in Paediatrics continuing education courses
- [International Meeting on Indigenous Child Health](https://cps.ca/en/imich): International Meeting on Indigenous Child Health conference and registration

## Advocacy & Strategic Priorities

- [Advocacy Centre](https://cps.ca/en/advocacy-defense): CPS Advocacy Centre for child health policy and government relations
- [Strategic Priorities: 2024-2027](https://cps.ca/en/strategic-priorities): CPS strategic priorities 2024-2027 for child mental health and environment
- [Antiracism Initiative](https://cps.ca/en/policy-and-advocacy/antiracism-initiative): CPS antiracism initiative for diversity and equity in pediatric care
- [Indigenous Child & Youth Health](https://cps.ca/en/indigenoushealth): CPS Indigenous child and youth health resources and culturally safe care

## Public Resources

- [Caring for Kids](https://caringforkids.cps.ca): Caring for Kids: CPS parent-focused child health information resource

## Organization

- [Canadian Paediatric Society Home](https://cps.ca/en): Canadian Paediatric Society homepage: national association of paediatricians

- [Contact Us](https://cps.ca/en/about-apropos/staff): Contact information and staff directory for Canadian Paediatric Society
